Review prompt: the episode association is recorded as not established or is still unknown/incomplete, or the phase is unknown. Assess the medication timeline (antipsychotics, dopamine-blocking antiemetics, preventive anticholinergic changes), distribution and persistence of the abnormal postures, and exclusions (catatonia, primary neurological or medical cause, tardive movement disorder) with indicated examination before any anticholinergic discussion. Symptoms preceding exposure, unexplained focal findings, or progression unrelated to medication changes warrant further investigation. Safety: {urgent_text}. Regimen: {regimen_text}. Continuation: {continuation_text}. {unknown_disclosure}

Review prompt: the index episode is recorded as recently resolved with an established antipsychotic association. Review short-term recurrence prevention with the patient (lowest effective exposure for the shortest needed time; reassess over weeks to months whether prevention can be reduced or withdrawn), patient concerns about continuation, and the causative-regimen review below. This output never selects a product, dose, route, or duration and never prescribes routine prophylaxis. Safety: {urgent_text}. Regimen: {regimen_text}. Review acute anticholinergic treatment per current local labeling with the patient, including patient-specific safety concerns, age-related vulnerability, and concomitant anticholinergic burden below. description: Predefined physician-review wording for acute dystonia F4. The LLM never supplies this text; the app renders the matching branch deterministically from stored posteriors, evidence, and missingness. All slots are escaped at render time. No branch diagnoses dystonia, selects a product or dose, gives administration instructions, clears safety, or authorizes detention or quality measurement.

conditions.text: URGENT recorded finding: breathing difficulty, stridor, or suspected laryngeal involvement is recorded. Stridor or breathing difficulty can indicate laryngeal dystonia and requires emergency assessment. Do not delay airway evaluation to complete a diagnostic checklist. Seek immediate senior/emergency evaluation per local emergency protocol. Do not await model output.

deterministic_urgent_flag.otherwise: No deterministic urgent flag fires; the posterior branch above still requires physician review.
deterministic_urgent_flag.rule: Rendered directly from saved inputs WITHOUT waiting for any LLM request, inference result, or template posterior. Shown alongside (never replaced by) the posterior branch.

mapping_rule: Render the branch matching the highest-posterior AcuteDystoniaReviewPathway state ONLY as a review prompt; the posterior maximum is not a validated recommendation rule and the physician may choose any course. Always render the stored AnticholinergicSafetyReviewFocus, AcuteDystoniaAnticholinergicContinuationReview, and AcuteDystoniaAntipsychoticRegimenReview posteriors alongside. Always append unknown_disclosure. Always evaluate deterministic_urgent_flag from saved inputs first.
